summary: Qfin Holdings filed a Form 6-K with its Q1 2026 unaudited results (period ended March 31, 2026). The press release details business metrics: cumulative registered users 297.5M (+11% YoY), total loan volume RMB65,034M (-26.8% YoY), 90-day+ delinquency rate 3.50%. No merger, acquisition, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event is described. The filing is a routine earnings report by a foreign private issuer, with no extraordinary corporate action. There are no deal terms, catalysts, or risk-arb angle. The non-US issuer maps to a standard earnings release under 20-F/6-K regime.
